scope: Deterministic synthetic streaming fixture at the documented GTCRN streaming ONNX boundary with a caller-supplied-asset reference; no selection, real-model, device, listening, benchmark, provider or release claim.

documented_constraints: CPUExecutionProvider only, one ONNX session per adapter instance
one 257-bin real/imag STFT frame per call with shape [1,257,1,2]
conv_cache [2,1,16,16,33], tra_cache [2,3,1,1,16] and inter_cache [2,1,33,16] persist across calls and are zeroed by reset
512-point square-root-Hann analysis/synthesis window with a 256-sample hop
process() resets model caches per utterance and pads 256 samples on both sides
frame shape mismatches and inputs shorter than two samples raise
source_identity.note: Source inspection is a boundary anchor only. No ONNX session is created and no model weight is loaded here.

frontend_contract.note: The installed v0 frontend contract is recorded and preserved. The model hop below is task-local geometry and is not an installed v0 geometry change.

public_boundary.note: No public header, contract, descriptor, registry, shared build, CMake file, CI file or installed behavior is modified.

acceptance_profile.name: enhancement
mapped_cases: alignment, state, memory and timing boundary
not_applicable: unpaired-speech predictive screen or authorized listening: no licensed speech or listening result
target-device timing and memory: no exact runtime measurement
remaining_gates: rights-cleared exact weight asset and ONNX Runtime build
independent listening or authorized predictive screen

independent_timing_evidence.note: Source-reported RTF and frame timings are provenance only. They are not reproduced, pooled as a controlled benchmark, assigned to this surrogate or used as an acceptance threshold.

rights_gap.evidence: No weight file, checkpoint license text or ONNX Runtime redistribution grant is present or downloaded here.
rights_gap.consequence: No vendoring, build, installed provider, descriptor, default or release claim until rights are cleared.

invariants: Only this task directory is written; no shared SDK file, CMake, contract, public header, registry, default, board, handoff, CI file or installed behavior changes.
The fixture is opt-in, unregistered and disabled by default with no C provider or production callback.
The caller-supplied-asset path fails closed and never silently falls back to the surrogate.
All signals are frozen deterministic synthetic floats; no model, media, weight or runtime asset is read or produced.
Configuration, hop shape, finite range, epoch, position and lifecycle rejections fail closed without advancing stream state.
Identity and noisy-input controls are reported with the candidate; regressions are recorded verbatim.
Three cold-start passes are byte-identical; canonical JSON and digest sidecars are regenerated deterministically.
Source-reported timing and the prior dereverberation screen are proposal-only provenance, never measured results or thresholds.
Missing evidence never qualifies the candidate; decision remains DEFER and conclusion not_ready.
blockers: No exact GTCRN weight asset with an immutable URI, SHA-256 and byte size is available.
No checkpoint license or ONNX Runtime redistribution terms are cleared for packaging.
No real streaming ONNX parity, paired denoising cohort, listening or target-device timing exists.
No provider intake, descriptor, catalog or default-selection review has been completed.
No exact approved external reference parity result exists.
reopening_conditions: An authorized caller supplies a rights-cleared immutable weight asset with SHA-256, byte size, license and pinned ONNX Runtime version.
Rerun real streaming parity with preserved hop, state and lookahead at the documented boundary.
Run a held-out real paired denoising cohort with matched identity and noisy controls and paired SI-SDR/STOI.
Run independent listening or a separately labeled authorized predictive screen.
Measure content/availability timing, memory and deadlines on the exact target runtime.
Complete provider intake and explicit default-selection review before any registry or catalog change.
